\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{متابع} (mutābiʿ)}{متابع (mutābiʿ)}]{\ar{متابع} (mutābiʿ) — a follower; an observer}

\label{lesson:AR-C356-mutabi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for an editorial, then the Arabic for to deny officially.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{متابع}}
\textbf{\ar{متابع}} — \emph{mutābiʿ} — \textquotedblleft{}a follower; an observer\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ar{للمغنية} \ar{مليون} \ar{متابع}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{li-l-mughanniya milyūn mutābiʿ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The singer has a million followers.
\end{quote}

Also someone who follows the news closely.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{متابع}} (\emph{mutābiʿ}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{t-b-ʿ} (Lane), \textquotedblleft{}to follow\textquotedblright{}. \emph{Mutābiʿ} is the participle of the taught \emph{tābaʿa}, \textquotedblleft{}one who keeps following\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mutābiʿ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mutābiʿ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{li-l-mughanniya milyūn mutābiʿ.} — The singer has a million followers.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Arabic for an editorial, then the Arabic for to deny officially, then say \emph{mutābiʿ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ar{متابع} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A follower; an observer\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{مشاهد} (mushāhid)}{مشاهد (mushāhid)}]{\ar{مشاهد} (mushāhid) — a viewer, a spectator}

\label{lesson:AR-C356-mushahid}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for to deny officially, then the Arabic for a follower.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{مشاهد}}
\textbf{\ar{مشاهد}} — \emph{mushāhid} — \textquotedblleft{}a viewer, a spectator\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ar{كتب} \ar{مشاهد} \ar{رسالة} \ar{إلى} \ar{القناة}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kataba mushāhid risāla ilā al-qanāh.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
A viewer wrote a letter to the channel.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{مشاهد}} (\emph{mushāhid}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{sh-h-d} (Lane), \textquotedblleft{}to be present, to witness\textquotedblright{}. \emph{Mushāhid} is the participle of the taught \emph{shāhada}, to watch.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for telling what happened.

One more word for telling what happened.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{مصور} (muṣawwir)}{مصور (muṣawwir)}]{\ar{مصور} (muṣawwir) — a photographer; a camera operator}

\label{lesson:AR-C356-musawwir}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for a viewer, then the Arabic for a listener.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{مصور}}
\textbf{\ar{مصور}} — \emph{muṣawwir} — \textquotedblleft{}a photographer; a camera operator\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ar{التقط} \ar{المصور} \ar{صورا} \ar{للعروسين}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{iltaqaṭa al-muṣawwir ṣuwaran li-l-ʿarūsayn.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{مصور}} (\emph{muṣawwir}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{ṣ-w-r} (Lane), the root of the taught \emph{ṣūra}, a picture. \emph{Muṣawwir} is the participle of \emph{ṣawwara}, \textquotedblleft{}one who makes pictures\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{غطى} (ghaṭṭā)}{غطى (ghaṭṭā)}]{\ar{غطى} (ghaṭṭā) — to cover; to report on}

\label{lesson:AR-C356-ghatta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for a listener, then the Arabic for a photographer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{غطى}}
\textbf{\ar{غطى}} — \emph{ghaṭṭā} — \textquotedblleft{}to cover; to report on\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ar{غطى} \ar{المراسل} \ar{المباراة} \ar{من} \ar{الملعب}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ghaṭṭā al-murāsil al-mubārāh min al-malʿab.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The correspondent covered the match from the stadium.
\end{quote}

Present: \ar{يغطي}, \emph{yughaṭṭī}.

Of a blanket too: \ar{غطت} \ar{الأم} \ar{الطفل}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{غطى}} (\emph{ghaṭṭā}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{gh-ṭ-w} (Lane), the root of the taught \emph{ghiṭāʾ}, a cover. It is Form II, \textquotedblleft{}to put a cover over\textquotedblright{}; the press sense matches English cover and is usually taken as modelled on it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ghaṭṭā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ghaṭṭā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ghaṭṭā al-murāsil al-mubārāh min al-malʿab.} — The correspondent covered the match from the stadium.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Arabic for a listener, then the Arabic for a photographer, then say \emph{ghaṭṭā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ar{غطى} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To cover; to report on\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 349–356 — a review}

\label{lesson:AR-R356-review-349-356}



\begin{quote}
Say the Arabic for for the first time and by mistake.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item for the first time, by mistake, the day before yesterday, someday, right after
  \item a publisher, an edition, a printed copy, a leaflet, a supplement
  \item to deceive, to cheat, to swindle, to forge, to conceal
  \item an offence, a fine, a brawl, a commotion, a crowd
  \item a demonstration, to gather, to cheer, to break into, to spread
  \item wreckage, ash, a spark, a flame, to leak
  \item urgent, a blog, a comment, an editorial, to deny officially
  \item a follower, a viewer, a listener, a photographer, to cover
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
For the first time? (\textbf{\ar{للمرة} \ar{الأولى}}, \emph{li-l-marra al-ūlā}.) By mistake? (\textbf{\ar{عن} \ar{طريق} \ar{الخطأ}}, \emph{ʿan ṭarīq al-khaṭaʾ}.) The day before yesterday? (\textbf{\ar{أول} \ar{أمس}}, \emph{awwal ams}.) Someday? (\textbf{\ar{يوما} \ar{ما}}, \emph{yawman mā}.) Right after? (\textbf{\ar{عقب}}, \emph{ʿaqiba}.) A publisher? (\textbf{\ar{ناشر}}, \emph{nāshir}.) An edition? (\textbf{\ar{طبعة}}, \emph{ṭabʿa}.) A printed copy? (\textbf{\ar{نسخة}}, \emph{nuskha}.) A leaflet? (\textbf{\ar{منشور}}, \emph{manshūr}.) A supplement? (\textbf{\ar{ملحق}}, \emph{mulḥaq}.) To deceive? (\textbf{\ar{خدع}}, \emph{khadaʿa}.) To cheat? (\textbf{\ar{غش}}, \emph{ghashsha}.) To swindle? (\textbf{\ar{احتال}}, \emph{iḥtāla}.) To forge? (\textbf{\ar{زور}}, \emph{zawwara}.) To conceal? (\textbf{\ar{أخفى}}, \emph{akhfā}.) An offence? (\textbf{\ar{مخالفة}}, \emph{mukhālafa}.) A fine? (\textbf{\ar{غرامة}}, \emph{gharāma}.) A brawl? (\textbf{\ar{شجار}}, \emph{shijār}.) A commotion? (\textbf{\ar{ضجة}}, \emph{ḍajja}.) A crowd? (\textbf{\ar{حشد}}, \emph{ḥashd}.) A demonstration? (\textbf{\ar{مظاهرة}}, \emph{muẓāhara}.) To gather? (\textbf{\ar{تجمع}}, \emph{tajammaʿa}.) To cheer? (\textbf{\ar{هتف}}, \emph{hatafa}.) To break into? (\textbf{\ar{اقتحم}}, \emph{iqtaḥama}.) To spread? (\textbf{\ar{انتشر}}, \emph{intashara}.) Wreckage? (\textbf{\ar{حطام}}, \emph{ḥuṭām}.) Ash? (\textbf{\ar{رماد}}, \emph{ramād}.) A spark? (\textbf{\ar{شرارة}}, \emph{sharāra}.) A flame? (\textbf{\ar{لهب}}, \emph{lahab}.) To leak? (\textbf{\ar{تسرب}}, \emph{tasarraba}.) Urgent? (\textbf{\ar{عاجل}}, \emph{ʿājil}.) A blog? (\textbf{\ar{مدونة}}, \emph{mudawwana}.) A comment? (\textbf{\ar{تعليق}}, \emph{taʿlīq}.) An editorial? (\textbf{\ar{افتتاحية}}, \emph{iftitāḥiyya}.) To deny officially? (\textbf{\ar{نفى}}, \emph{nafā}.) A follower? (\textbf{\ar{متابع}}, \emph{mutābiʿ}.) A viewer? (\textbf{\ar{مشاهد}}, \emph{mushāhid}.) A listener? (\textbf{\ar{مستمع}}, \emph{mustamiʿ}.) A photographer? (\textbf{\ar{مصور}}, \emph{muṣawwir}.) To cover? (\textbf{\ar{غطى}}, \emph{ghaṭṭā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
